submit.title: Submit a Help Request
submit.free_note: Your first case is FREE. After that, a 1 credit listing fee applies.
submit.selfie_hint: Take a clear selfie to verify your identity. This must be a live photo, not a pre-existing image.
submit.video_hint: Explain your situation clearly in your video statement:
video_points: What challenge are you facing and why do you need help?
What is your financial situation and how does this impact your daily life?
What do you hope to achieve with this support?
submit.video_warning: The video must be up to 90 seconds to keep file size under 50 MB.
submit.confirm: I confirm all information is true and accurate
submit.agree: I have read all the Terms & Conditions and I agree to them.
